title: Data and code for: Characterizing runoff response to rainfall in permafrost catchments and its implications for hydrological and biogeochemical fluxes in a warming climate
description: Data, ERRA (Ensemble Rainfall-Runoff Analysis) scripts, and MATLAB figure code accompanying the HESS manuscript 'Characterizing runoff response to rainfall in permafrost catchments and its implications for hydrological and biogeochemical fluxes in a warming climate' (Culha et al.). Covers the Upper Kuparuk (Toolik) and Cape Bounty catchments.
